_comment: DESIGN.md §6. Damage type (row) vs armor type (column). Every row and column sums to 4.1. ONE CYCLE, not two pairs: arcane beats flesh and is weak to ward, blast beats swarm and is weak to flesh, pierce beats plate and is weak to swarm, impact beats ward and is weak to plate - so every damage type is strong against one armor and weak against another, and no two types form a closed little pair of their own (the old chart was two halves: impact/arcane with swarm/ward, pierce/blast with flesh/plate). Tuning: 1.4/0.7 flattens the spread, 1.75/0.5 sharpens it.
